newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp says US unit near break even.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp says US unit near break even.

text.p: Southcorp Holdings Ltd chief executive officer Graham Kraehe said on Thursday its American Water Heater business was around break even point after a run of losses.
"We are rumbling along at the moment on a break-even zone," Kraehe told the American Chamber of Commerce in Australia luncheon.
The American Water Heater group has lost money for Southcorp since it bought the business in July 1992.
Losses from the American Water Heater business, formerly Mor-Flo, halved in the six months to December 31, 1996 compared with the June half loss of A$2.1 million.
Kraehe also said that Southcorp was close to expanding its packaging business in Asia.
"In packaging, we said we were close to expanding in Asia. We are still close to expanding there but the ink has yet to dry," he said.
Kraehe said in March that Southcorp was eyeing acquisitions in wine and in areas of packaging either in Australia, North America or Asia.
